ADR 0091: copied registration-time CLR declarations preserve static, virtual/final/abstract and typed params semantics, project inheritance and nonpublic visibility. ScriptTests.MethodMetadata verifies compiled calls, independent snapshots, unbound/disposed wrappers and process-held registration lifetime. File-backed assemblies, matching portable PDBs and untrimmed declarations are required; embedded NativeAOT source registration is unsupported. See [MethodFlags audit](../method-flags.md) for bit-specific applicability and the open editor eligibility consumer.
